intro: We provide architecture, interior design and visualisation, from the first concept to supervision on site. One studio carries the project through design, permits and construction, so nothing gets lost between phases. Outside Serbia we work together with your local architect of record.

phases.title: Conceptual & Schematic Design
phases.text: We turn your brief into a clear spatial strategy, starting with a pattern study of the site and of the way the building will be used. This phase covers site analysis, the planning conditions and the first concepts: layout, massing and the relationships between spaces.

items.title: Site Analysis
items.text: Topography, orientation, views, access and the planning rules that apply to the plot.

items.title: Pattern Study
items.text: The recurring relationships of light, movement, privacy and gathering that the design has to answer.

items.title: Massing and Form
items.text: Early 3D models that test the volumes on the site, and the form that follows from the patterns.

phases.title: Design Development & 3D Modeling
phases.text: We develop the design in a precise 3D model in Rhino. Materials are chosen, and structure and building services are coordinated with the engineers, so junctions are resolved in the model before they reach the site.

items.title: 3D Model as Reference
items.text: Every dimension is checked in 3D, and plans, sections and elevations are taken from the model.

items.title: Coordination with Engineers
items.text: Structure and building services are checked against the architecture at each step.

items.title: Material Specification
items.text: Finishes and systems chosen for how they look, what they cost and how they will be built.

phases.title: Architectural Visualisation
phases.text: Photorealistic images, from the first massing studies to the final choice of materials. Renders are made from the same 3D model as the drawings, so what you approve is what gets documented.

items.title: Concept Visuals
items.text: Early images that test massing, light and atmosphere before the design is fixed.

items.title: Material and Interior Studies
items.text: Close views of finishes, furniture and lighting, so decisions can be made with confidence.

items.title: Presentation Imagery
items.text: High-resolution images for investors, permit submissions and sales.

phases.title: Construction Documents & Engineering
phases.text: Drawings, specifications and schedules that contractors can price and build from. Careful detailing means more accurate bids, fewer changes on site and documents that meet the applicable building codes.

items.title: Architectural Drawings
items.text: Plans, sections and elevations with the dimensions and notes a contractor needs to price the work.

items.title: Construction Details
items.text: Drawings of junctions, the thermal envelope and waterproofing, where most problems on site begin.

items.title: Permit Documentation
items.text: Documents that meet the applicable codes. In Serbia: IDR, PGD and PZI, submitted through the CEOP e-permit system.

phases.title: Construction Administration & Oversight
phases.text: After the building permit is issued, clients can engage us to supervise the construction of our own projects. We visit the site, review contractor submittals and answer technical questions, so the building is built as it was designed.

items.title: Site Visits
items.text: Regular visits to check that the work follows the approved design and documentation.

items.title: Submittal Review
items.text: Shop drawings and material samples checked against the specification.

items.title: Design Queries and Changes
items.text: Answers to contractors' technical questions, and proposed changes assessed against the approved design.

phases.title: Interior Architecture & Custom Detailing
phases.text: We carry the architectural idea into the interior: custom joinery, lighting and the choice of materials, so that the building and its interior read as one.

items.title: Custom Joinery
items.text: Cabinetry and built-in elements drawn to the geometry of each space.

items.title: Lighting Design
items.text: Lighting plans that follow how each space is used, by day and at night.

items.title: Materials and Hardware
items.text: Interior finishes, fixtures and hardware that follow the architectural idea.

phases.title: Feasibility Studies & Master Planning
phases.text: For larger sites we test what can be built before design begins: how much floor area the planning rules allow, how it can be placed on the land and in which order it can be built. Our pattern-based tools let us compare many variants at this stage, with their areas and indices side by side.

items.title: Site Capacity
items.text: The maximum buildable area under the planning rules, and the constraints that limit it.

items.title: Variants and Density
items.text: Several layouts with their areas and indices, so the investor can compare them by the numbers.

items.title: Phasing
items.text: A large development divided into stages that can be financed and built one after another.
